findings.title: Hidden import input has no independent accessible name
findings.observed: The Settings screenshot/session exposed one 1x1 hidden file input without aria-label, label or aria-labelledby. The visible 导入 JSON 备份 button is labeled and triggers it, so this is a semantic hardening item rather than a blocked user path.
findings.proposedDirection: Give the file input an explicit accessible name or remove it from the accessibility tree while preserving the visible labeled trigger.
